evals.prompt: Create a BeatGrove swamp artist house for a contributor using ChatGPT without repository access. It should be a poor, decaying bayou shack with a transparent background.
evals.expected_output: Use contributor and art-direction references; inspect a style reference; create isolated painted art with readable entrance and margins using available image tools. State a missing tool honestly; repository access is unnecessary.

evals.prompt: My approved BeatGrove house source PNG is 1.6 MB. Produce a compact transparent export while retaining the original.
evals.expected_output: Use the contributor export helper when processing tools are available; retain the master, inspect transparency and report actual dimensions and bytes. Do not promise a byte limit from prompting alone.

evals.prompt: Integrate an approved forest house into the BeatGrove world and keep artist overrides intact.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the authoritative checkout and current runtime; transform a measured doorway anchor; add the forest pool entry; verify stable selection and override precedence, then perform required project checks. Distinguish structural validation from live visual review.
